source: Masa CMS 7.6.1 on Adobe ColdFusion 2023 and SQL Server 2022 (site default at http://localhost:20180, debugging output on), each answer a GET of path by the S2 admin. The default site holds the private groups Admin and Editor and the public groups Alpha, Beta and Gamma with the tags, interests, addresses, favorite and membership the PostgreSQL suite seeds. body is the exact response text, except that error.stacktrace is removed where stacktraceRemoved is set; detail keeps the SQL Server or ColdFusion message of a 500. family names the behaviour; refusal names the case identity answers with the legacy 503 of its exceptions-list entry instead.
